Optional personal support

A conversation, only if it is useful.

The website is designed to offer reflection and practical ways forward without requiring a consultation. If, after exploring the ideas, you still prefer a personal conversation, this option is available.

Introductory conversation

A 30-minute reflection conversation about a question or recurring pattern. ₹500. Phone, Zoom, WhatsApp call or offline by arrangement.

Individual reflection

A focused conversation for examining a concern, reaction or practical next step.

Group conversation

A respectful group format can be discussed case by case.

Please message before paying to arrange a suitable time. This is for reflection and personal development, not therapy or crisis support.
